Real-time earthquake early warning system.\nKeep safe with instant seismic alerts powered by IoT technology.
QuakeAlert connects to a network of ESP32 microcontrollers equipped with seismic sensors.\n\nWhen an earthquake is detected, you receive a notification so you can prepare.
To receive earthquake alerts, QuakeAlert needs permission to send you notifications. This is critical for your app functionality.
To ensure alerts are never delayed, QuakeAlert needs to run without battery restrictions. It keeps connection alive 24/7.
QuakeAlert uses your location to calculate distance from earthquakes and show relevant alerts. Required for accurate warnings.
